comparison.objective: Lead a line for at least one full round turn around a bollard, place its end in a tray, and release it.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable-line wrapping and end placement versus rigid mandrel stabilization, hammering, withdrawal, and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: At least one full turn under the cap, end in the right tray, both grippers released.
comparison.reason: A tray and bimanual release are incidental similarities; the tested ability is rope topology, not controlled metal fracture.
